This is about unrecognized change to SSO configuration, potential compromise. Also part 3 says review looks at credentials exposure case by case.

Thus we can answer based on policy. Provide guidance: report as potential compromise, steps: treat as suspicious, investigate, possibly revert SSO config, check for credential exposure, etc. The policy excerpt gives some info. We can answer.
